releases.body:
The check-in now claims the **one-time newcomer tasks** — the eight on Loomy's onboarding board, worth **10000 points** in all — beside the daily grant: serially, highest value first, idempotent on the upstream's `alreadyCompleted`, and a refusal among them never touches the daily claim's own result. The first check-in of a fresh account typically refreshes the grant *and* lands the newcomer purse in one go.

The usage card also carries an **aside row** with the still-claimable sum while any of it stands (one read per session per run; the check-in's round clears it) — a purse spent once has no window to consume, so it never drives the percentages.

The README in this release carries the model table as the gateway actually served it on **2026-10-28** (thirteen models, three of them image generation), and the docs' wording is tightened.

Install:

```
magpie plugin add @roadkid/opencode-loomy-auth
```

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/road-kid/opencode-loomy-auth/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

The package moves to **`@roadkid/opencode-loomy-auth`** — the community `@magpie-community` scope publishes from the [magpie-community/plugins](https://github.com/magpie-community/plugins) organization, which this plugin has not joined, so its scope cannot be published under from a personal account (the registry answers 404). Same code as 0.1.1: the usage-card percentage and check-in state fixes. The README in this release also carries the model table as the gateway actually served it on 2026-10-28 (thirteen models, three of them image generation) and the docs no longer print the signing pair.

Install:

```
magpie plugin add @roadkid/opencode-loomy-auth
```

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/road-kid/opencode-loomy-auth/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

## Fixed

- The usage card's percentage was forever 0%. The pair it computed from (`dailyRemainingPoints`/`dailyLimitPoints`) never comes back from the live upstream, and the `dailyBalance` the card fell back to showing alone is the grant's *remaining*, not its size. The consumed share now reads `(quota − remaining) / quota` off the remaining, with the quota taken from the answer when it carries one (`dailyQuota`, or the older pair) or from the size the check-in notes per account — kept in memory for the run and in a `.loomy-quota.json` beside the plugin across restarts, so it takes a check-in (the Daily check-in switch, or Check in now) to write the first note. Without a quota the card shows the remaining alone; no share is invented and no quota is assumed. (#1)
- The check-in reported *claimed* for every success. The answer's `alreadyProcessed` tells the day's renewal from a repeat: a repeat now reports *done* (「今日已刷新」, with what is left of the grant), and the day's first reports *claimed* — with the gain as its credit when the answer carries the whole arithmetic (`dailyQuota` − `dailyConsumed`). (#1)

## Added

- `LOOMY_QUOTA_CACHE_FILE` moves the quota cache file.
- A `CHANGELOG.md`.

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/road-kid/opencode-loomy-auth/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

releases.name: v0.1.0 — Loomy provider plugin for OpenCode / magpie
releases.body:
Phone-code sign-in, OpenAI-compatible chat relay (dual token headers, quota errors rewritten as 429 rate_limit_error for account failover), live model catalog with capabilities and reasoning-effort variants, dual point wallets on the Usage card, and the daily first-login refresh as check-in. Zero runtime dependencies (node:crypto + fetch only), Bun/Node dual compatible, 50 offline tests against a local fake upstream.

手机验证码登录；OpenAI 兼容转发（双 token 头，额度不足错误改写为 429 供账号切换）；实时模型清单（能力位 + reasoning-effort 档位）；积分双钱包 Usage 卡片；每日 first-login 刷新即签到。零运行时依赖，Bun/Node 双兼容，50 个断网测试。

Install / 安装：
```sh
magpie plugin add github:road-kid/opencode-loomy-auth
```
